blocks.content: Puzzle questions provide a set of conditions and ask you to arrange people/objects in a specific order (floors, boxes, days, etc.). These are high-weightage questions in  CGL Tier 2 and also appear in Tier 1 as 2–3 question sets.

cells:
Step 1: Read ALL clues once before attempting.

Step 2: Identify the type: floor/box/days/months/year.

Step 3: Note definite placements first (e.g., 'A lives on top floor').

Step 4: Use elimination: if A is confirmed somewhere, remove A from other positions.

Step 5: Use relative clues (above/below, before/after) to narrow down.

Step 6: Try the most constrained clue first — the one with fewest options.

Step 7: Make a table/grid. Rows = positions, Columns = attributes.

blocks.content: 7 people A, B, C, D, E, F, G live on 7 floors (Floor 1 = bottom, Floor 7 = top). Conditions: (i) A lives on floor 4. (ii) B lives immediately above C. (iii) D lives on an odd-numbered floor. (iv) F lives below E. (v) G lives on floor 6. (vi) D lives above A. (vii) C does not live on floor 1.

Sol. Fixed: A=4, G=6. D on odd floor, above A(4) → D = 5 or 7. G=6, so D=5 or 7. B immediately above C, C not on floor 1. Remaining floors: 1,2,3,5,7 for B,C,D,E,F. D=5 or 7. If D=5: remaining 1,2,3,7 for B,C,E,F. B above C, C≠1. C can be 2,3 → B=3,4? A=4, so B=3 if C=2. Remaining 1,7 for E,F. F below E → F=1, E=7. Check: F(1)<E(7)✓. Final: C=2,B=3,A=4,D=5,G=6,E=7,F=1. ✓ All conditions satisfied.
5 boxes P, Q, R, S, T are stacked one over the other. Conditions: (i) T is immediately above S. (ii) P is at the top. (iii) Q is between S and P. (iv) R is above T.

Sol. P is at top = position 5. T immediately above S. R above T. Order from bottom: S, T, R below some positions. R above T, so R > T > S. Q between S and P: S < Q < P(5). So Q is at 4 (just below P). Remaining positions for R,T,S: 1,2,3. T immediately above S: if S=1,T=2. R above T: R=3. Final from bottom to top: S(1), T(2), R(3), Q(4), P(5). Ans: Bottom to Top: S−T−R−Q−P

6 people A,B,C,D,E,F have their birthdays in 6 different months: Jan, Mar, May, Jul, Sep, Nov. (i) A's birthday is in May. (ii) B's birthday is 2 months before E's. (iii) C's birthday is in a month before A's. (iv) D's birthday is after F's. (v) E's birthday is not in the last month.

Sol. A=May. C before A → C=Jan or Mar. B is 2 months before E. Options: B=Jan,E=Mar | B=Mar,E=May(taken) | B=Jul,E=Sep | B=Sep,E=Nov. E not in last month(Nov) → E≠Nov → B=Jul,E=Sep works. B=Jan,E=Mar: C must be before May, C≠Jan(B) → C=Mar=E? No conflict if E=Mar. Let's try B=Jul,E=Sep. Remaining Jan,Mar,Nov for C,D,F. C before A(May) → C=Jan or Mar. D after F. If C=Jan: D,F from Mar,Nov. D>F → F=Mar,D=Nov. Final: C=Jan,F=Mar,A=May,B=Jul,E=Sep,D=Nov. ✓
Q.55 5 books are stacked. Maths is above Science but below English. Hindi is at the bottom. Computers is above English. What is the order from bottom to top?
Ans: (a) Hindi-Science-Maths-English-Computers Hint: Hindi(1)<Science<Maths<English<Computers(5). Only option (a) satisfies all.
Q.56 7 people sit on 7 floors. A is on 3rd floor. B is on a floor below C which is on 5th floor. D is on top floor. E is immediately below D. Where is B?
Ans: (b) 4th Hint: D=7th, E=6th, C=5th. B below C → B=4th or below. A=3rd. B≠3rd. B=4th works with remaining. Ans: 4th.
